title: Query authorized Kanbus boards by project, type and stage
description:
As a project member, I want generic issue queries to load the boards I am authorized to see so my selection never exposes another tenant or unauthorized project.

Feature: Tenant-safe generic board queries
  Scenario Outline: Load an authorized project scope
    Given mixed issue types and stages across authorized and unauthorized projects
    When a board query selects <project_scope> and <type_scope>
    Then only matching issues in the authenticated tenant and authorized selected projects are returned
    And existing stage filters, declared ordering and pagination are preserved
    Examples:
      | project_scope | type_scope |
      | one project | all types |
      | one project | selected types |
      | selected projects | all types |
      | selected projects | selected types |
      | all authorized projects | all types |
      | all authorized projects | selected types |
  Scenario: Read an exact full ID directly
    Given an authorized project and an exact full issue ID
    When a client reads that issue
    Then the canonical issue is fetched without enumerating board pages
    And the same tenant and project authorization is enforced
  Scenario: Reject cross-tenant or unauthorized project access
    Given two tenants and projects with different member access
    When a member supplies an unauthorized project, issue ID, object pointer or cursor
    Then the request is rejected without exposing content or changing records
  Scenario: Preserve filters across project fanout
    Given issues with interleaved sort values across selected projects
    When the client requests successive pages with selected types and stage filters
    Then results obey the declared global ordering with a deterministic identity tie-break
    And no matching issue is silently omitted or duplicated across the pages
    And the cursor cannot be reused under a different scope or query
  Scenario: Observe a recently committed write
    Given a successful canonical mutation whose query projection has not converged
    When the writer reloads that issue directly
    Then the committed revision is available
    And query freshness is reported without promising immediate catalog convergence
  Scenario: Continue a filtered page
    Given a filtered query page with no matches and a continuation cursor
    When the client requests remaining pages
    Then later matching records are not silently omitted
  Scenario: Verify a realistic board load
    Given realistic mixed projects, types, stages and large canonical records
    When the supported board access patterns are exercised
    Then validation records result correctness, pages, catalog requests and canonical content fetches
    And selected-project and type queries avoid fetching unrelated canonical content
    And the report identifies query fanout and observed limitations rather than extrapolating from an empty board

This is the generic storage/query contract and its test target. The current Prospectus UI proof is single-project. Multi-project navigation and selection UI are future backlog, not a current shipped claim. Indexes serve these access patterns; time analytics, S3 Tables and Athena are out of scope.
